thread:
Maya (Marketing): Quick kickoff: we want an OSS reference app, three short tutorials, and a community webinar next week. Primary goals: repo stars, webinar signups, inbound trial leads.
Liam (DevEx): sounds good. I'll create the repo skeleton and 3 labs: 1) local quickstart, 2) deploy to Dedicated, 3) cost tuning + quantization. each ~15 mins.
Priya (Product Marketing): we'll need a 2-paragraph launch post + a benchmark blurb (latency @128 tokens and cost/1k). Ravi, can you run perf?
Ravi (Eng): yes — I'll run baseline on staging GPU and a quantized CPU run. Deliverables: CSV, short one-paragraph summary, and a shell snippet to reproduce. Will note instance types.
Sam (Sales Ops): inbound capture plan: HubSpot form with utm_campaign=refapp_launch, webhook to #sales-inbound, tag leads as "refapp_interest". I'll build the form by Tue.
Juno (Community): webinar proposal: 30m demo (Liam + power user) + 20m Q&A. I'll recruit a community co-presenter and post in forum.
Maya (Marketing): messaging variants: technical, product-value, enterprise. Priya to draft 3 CTAs for A/B test.
Liam (DevEx): will add Dockerfile, minimal k8s manifest, CONTRIBUTING.md, and a good-first-issue label template.
Priya (Product Marketing): legal will need to sign off on benchmark wording — I'll loop them once Ravi posts numbers.
Ravi (Eng): ack. I'll include a short footnote template for the post describing test conditions.
Maya (Marketing): timeline: Mon - repo & tutorials draft; Tue - perf + graphics; Wed - landing page + HubSpot; Thu - post draft + legal sign-off; Fri - dry run; Launch = next Mon. Everyone ack?
All: ack.
Maya (Marketing): great — I'll own PR outreach and daily updates in this thread. :rocket:
